title: Regional Honey Testing Laboratory serves beekeepers and FPOs
summary: The on-campus RHTL supports beekeepers, farmer producer organisations and food businesses with quality, authenticity and safety testing, including sugar-profile and heavy-metal analysis.

title: Arbor Day tree-planting drive on the Amingaon campus
summary: Staff, incubatees and guests joined a campus-wide plantation drive, adding native species to the green cover around the Technology Incubation Centre.

title: Bio-entrepreneurial skills training and internship programme
summary: A five-day programme for undergraduate and postgraduate students from across Assam, combining laboratory exposure with the practical side of building a bio-venture.

title: NIDHI PRAYAS innovators move from drawing to prototype
summary: Pre-incubation teams used the park’s prototyping and fab-lab support to test designs, validate assumptions and prepare for the next stage of product development.

title: Thirteen ventures working from one campus
summary: From genomics and enzymes to mead, medtech and fisheries, the park’s incubatee community now spans thirteen resident companies and institutions.

title: Student exposure visits and hands-on instrument training
summary: School, college and university groups visited the park for guided laboratory sessions on analytical instruments, bioinformatics and applied biotechnology.

title: PMMSY’s 4th anniversary and the BICFA story
summary: Guwahati Biotech Park joined the national celebration of four years of the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana, the programme funding the park’s fisheries and aquaculture incubation centre.

title: International Biomanufacturing Summit 2025
summary: GBP was an organising partner at the summit hosted with NEISED and Gauhati University, and welcomed DBT senior advisers for a working session with regional entrepreneurs.

title: GBP at the India International Science Festival 2024
summary: The park joined the State’s science and technology showcase at IIT Guwahati, with Dr Bula Choudhury speaking on innovation, technology and the start-up mission.

title: Assam at Global Bio-India 2024
summary: Assam participated as a State Partner at the fourth edition of Global Bio-India, where the park presented its facilities, BICFA, NIDHI PRAYAS and the State’s biotech policy.

title: BICFA biofloc and laboratory facility inaugurated
summary: The Business Incubation Centre for Fisheries and Aquaculture opened its biofloc setup and laboratory, alongside a training manual on ornamental fish farming and aquarium setup.

title: Students explore the labs through exposure visits
summary: Teams from Gauhati University, Gurucharan College, Tihu College and BBK College toured the instrumentation, greenhouse, cold room and incubation facilities through 2024.

title: AROHAN students visit the park
summary: Students from government schools in Darrang and Tinsukia explored the laboratories, instrumentation and BICFA’s fisheries incubation work during an AROHAN scheme visit.

title: Visit to Khaisua Foods and Iluscube
summary: The GBP team met founder Dhruba Jyoti Kalita to explore collaborations around ready-to-eat foods, ornamental fish and handcrafted planted aquariums.

title: Fuloni named Best Environmental Impact Startup
summary: Incubatee Fuloni was recognised at the TIA Awards 2024 for plantable, compostable and bioplastic alternatives to conventional horticulture pots.

title: Medinovation reaches the National Bio Entrepreneurship finale
summary: Park incubatee Medinovation Research and Consultancy reached the grand finale of the National Bio Entrepreneurship Competition and was shortlisted for a BioAngels investment proposal.
